newsitem.title: USA: USDA TO HOLD DATA USERS MEETING IN CHICAGO OCT 20.
newsitem.headline: USDA TO HOLD DATA USERS MEETING IN CHICAGO OCT 20.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department officials will outline upcoming changes in the department's statistical and information reports in a meeting with data users in Chicago on Oct 20, the department said Tuesday.

Representatives from the National Agricultural Statistics Service, the Agricultural Marketing Service, the Economic Research, the Foreign Agricultural Service and the World Agricultural Outlook Board will also take comments from users on how USDA can improve its reports.

The meeting will take place at the Holiday Inn Mart Plaza. For registration details, see the NASS home page at http://www.usda.gov/nass/ or contact Fred Vogel at (202) 720-3896 or fvogel@nass.usda.gov
